svg.title: Private Channels
svg.desc: A private channel sits inside an institution-controlled perimeter with view, approve, freeze, and move permissions. External observers cannot inspect channel activity, while an institution may grant auditor visibility. Value moves to and from Solana mainnet.
svg.text: private execution · institution-defined controls · Solana settlement

g.text: private · instant · no set transaction fee
permissions defined by the operating institution

svg.text: value moves to and from mainnet
